Class DcatDataset

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.properties.DcatResource
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.properties.DcatDataset
Direct Known Subclasses:
DcatCatalog, DcatDatasetSeries
public class DcatDataset extends DcatResource
DcatDataset describes a collection of data that is published or curated by a single agent (dcat:Dataset).
